# Sidon convention with repeated summands counted), all distinct.
sums = {}

    for j in range(i, len(P)):
        s = P[i] + P[j]
        require(s not in sums, f"collision {s} at ({P[i]},{P[j]}) vs {sums[s]}")
        sums[s] = (P[i], P[j])
require(len(sums) == len(P) * (len(P) + 1) // 2, "sum count mismatch")

# (ii) greedy rejection log: every n in [1,21]\P rejected; membership check n<=21.
rejections = []

        continue
    cand = P + [n]
    cs = {}

    for a in range(len(cand)):
        for b in range(a, len(cand)):
            s = cand[a] + cand[b]
            if s in cs:

fsums = [F[i] + F[j] for i in range(len(F)) for j in range(i, len(F))]
require(len(set(fsums)) == len(fsums) or len(F) <= 2, "F2 check")

require(P == [1, 2, 4, 8, 13, 21], "prefix drift")
